additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411725-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002795] Internal Error CRM:01811000721
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
After reviewing the logs, we can confirm that there was a temporary communication loss within the charger, which was subsequently restored. The charging session was not started due to an internal issue; however, we are pleased to inform you that one charging session was successfully started on Outlet 1, and the fault has been cleared.
If the issue persists, we kindly request your approval to update the firmware to the latest version in order to optimize the charger's performance.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

change

subject of this Email when
